$comment: Tested Alloy-Edge pairing. docs/compatibility.md is the human-readable record. edge is the contract baseline; edge_support.tested lists every release CI tests, newest first. Values here must match .github/workflows/ci.yml, examples/edge-observability/Dockerfile, docs/compatibility.md, and (collector) .github/workflows/newbenchmark-only.yml and .github/workflows/bench-gate.yml (checked by crates/ferrum-alloy-edge/tests/pairing.rs). .github/workflows/edge-bump.yml proposes new releases. alloy records the latest Alloy release (published true means it is released as the Git tag alloy.tag), while the Edge fields describe this checkout's tested matrix, which edge-bump.yml may move before the next Alloy release; distribution git means no registry publication (docs/release.md).

edge_support.policy: The latest Ferrum Edge release and the release before it. Older releases are unsupported.

transports.edge_to_alloy: https (h2 via ALPN) with mTLS client certificate
